title: Chapter 128 Splash Decomposition Attack
content:
Chapter 128 Splash Decomposition Attack

In the Zerg territory, Wu Qing was not idle either. He continued to think of ways to strengthen the defense capabilities of the Zerg territory.

The combination of weirdness and ghouls at night may bring some unexpected surprises, so he has to be cautious.

Wu Qing checked the prerequisites for upgrading the mother nest to two stars, and the completion rate was 7/10, of which the number of two-star creatures killed was 6, and the number of two-star creatures joining the camp was 1.

The extra two-star creatures joining the camp were contributed by Wu Cong. When he officially decided to join the Great Xia Territory, his strength was already two stars.

Only creatures that have reached the strength requirements before joining the system's camp will be counted into the number of joining the camp when joining, as a prerequisite for the mother nest to upgrade.

If the strength is improved within the camp to meet the strength requirements, it will not be counted because its luck originally belongs to the same camp.

For example, in the prerequisite for the mother nest to upgrade to one star, the Zerg Hydralisk has upgraded to one-star strength by itself, and they are not counted.

Wu Cong and his human wanderers were originally very strong.

Because of the loss of luck, they suffered various persecutions, and their strength was reduced to the current level. Only Wu Cong recovered to the two-star strength after a simple recuperation.

In this world, luck is directly related to the strength of individuals and forces. The increase or loss of luck will not directly affect the change of strength, but will indirectly affect it through other situations to achieve the goal.

Take Wu Cong and the human wanderers as examples. They have been suppressed by others, resulting in the continuous loss of luck. The continuous loss of luck led to the failure of the last struggle and eventually being captured.

But their own luck and strength are very strong. The rapid consumption of these lucks, coupled with their strong strength, jointly promoted their lucky completion of the bait mission, thereby harvesting a lot of luck.

The luck they just obtained was not enough to immediately reverse their fate. Therefore, after the consumption of these lucks, they finally encountered the Zerg after suffering hardships and were truly saved!

In this process, the various hardships they suffered were reflected in their bodies and minds, in various forms, causing their strength to continue to decline, and finally reduced to the current level.

Their injuries, illnesses, poisoning, secret techniques, restrictions, etc., are all the indirect reasons for their loss of strength after their luck is lost.

After Wu Cong and the human wanderers joined Daxia Territory, they were supported by the basic luck of the territory. Their luck no longer lost, but will gradually increase with the development and growth of Daxia Territory.

If they plunder the enemy's luck by killing the enemy on the battlefield, their luck will increase faster and their strength will recover quickly.

So, this group of human wanderers is really a potential stock.

If the prerequisites are not met, it is temporarily impossible to improve the strength of the entire Zerg by upgrading the mother nest.

It is not easy to find enemies with two-star strength. Wu Qing only hopes that at night, the ghouls will send a few second-star strength strongmen to kill the Zerg and upgrade the Zerg mother nest to two stars as soon as possible.

The two-star mother nest is still a little insufficient. Only when the Zerg mother nest is upgraded to three stars can the mother nest undergo a higher-level transformation and the entire Zerg can be qualitatively improved.

By then, the Zerg's combat arms will be more diverse, and the Zerg's biotechnology will be further unlocked.

Therefore, the Zerg's battle cannot stop! After a while, Wu Qing will start to worry about finding three-star enemies.

...

If you want to quickly improve the overall strength of the Zerg, in addition to the path of upgrading the mother nest, Wu Qing has another way to choose, that is, to independently research on the basis of the existing Zerg biotechnology to improve the strength of the Zerg.

This is also what Wu Qing has been doing.

A research that Wu Qing is looking forward to will soon produce results. This is the Zerg's genetic research project on giant ghouls.

When the gene sample of the giant ghoul was obtained, the Queen of the Zerg divided most of her energy to conduct in-depth research on the gene sample.

Relying on the powerful biotechnology of the Zerg and the magical gene modulation ability of the Zerg mother nest, the Queen of the Zerg analyzed, modulated, and tested the genes of the giant ghoul.

After unremitting efforts, the Queen of the Zerg finally successfully induced and activated a gene fragment hidden in Zerg units such as the Zerg Hydralisk through this research. This is a gene fragment that is somewhat similar to the gene of the giant ghoul.

When this gene fragment of the Zerg is activated, it will evolve the ability to spray Zerg biological decomposition fluid.

At this stage of the Zerg, only the Hydralisk and the defensive building anti-aircraft tower have this gene fragment, and they can evolve this ability.

Wu Qing called a Hydralisk, and the Queen of the Zerg wanted to conduct a separate evolution test on this Hydralisk to test the true situation of the Zerg after activating this gene fragment.

Under the air control of the Queen of the Zerg, this Hydralisk successfully activated a gene fragment hidden in the gene.

The Hydralisk did not turn into a pupa, nor did it consume the energy and gas resources of the system. Instead, it consumed its own energy and evolved some of the body structures and organs, giving it the ability to remotely spray Zerg biological decomposition fluid.

After the evolution, the Hydralisk has no change in appearance, but the change in ability will be tested in practice.

The first test is their original ability to spray spikes. This evolution cannot affect their existing combat power.

The hydralisk fires spikes at different frequencies, and the test results show that its original attack capability has not been affected.

Now, in addition to the spike attack, this evolved hydralisk has two more long-range attack modes.

The second attack mode of the hydralisk is a mixed attack of spikes and Zerg biodegradation liquid. Zerg biodegradation liquid is a liquid that is more terrible than the corrosive mucus of the giant ghoul, and there is almost nothing it cannot decompose.

In this long-range attack mode, the spikes sprayed by the hydralisk will be wrapped with a layer of Zerg degradation liquid. Its original powerful armor-piercing ability, coupled with the rapid decomposition ability of Zerg biodegradation liquid on substances, is very suitable for dealing with targets with particularly strong defensive capabilities.

If a spike cannot penetrate something, let the biodegradation liquid decompose it, and then add another spike later, it will definitely be easy to penetrate.

The third attack mode of the hydralisk is the Zerg biodegradation liquid spitting mode. The attack method is similar to that of the giant ghoul. In this attack mode, the hydralisk becomes a real saliva dragon.

They spray Zerg biodegradation fluid with a splashing effect, which can be sprayed and splashed onto numerous targets to form an area attack.
